title: Each guard and merge refusal matches its rule's outcome, no stricter or looser
why: Owner, Nov 1 20:57 CST: "so that sounds more like the merge tool being more restrictive than the prose said for it, and that's where the gap was ... a lot of what this repo is is just self improvement best practices so that my next project comes in faster, better than the last".
note: Sweep every guard rule and merge-tool refusal against the rule text it claims to hold. For each, say whether the refusal is exactly the rule's outcome, stricter, or looser; a stricter or looser one becomes a fix lane, or a rule rewrite on the owner's word. Incident: merge.py refused any merge while another ready PR ran CI, stricter than git-no-merge-during-batch-ci (fix in step overlapping-batches). Source: coordinator Nov 1 21:15 CST. Port: yes, the guards are shared. Ready. Sweep in draft PR #1029 (Nov 1 21:11 CST). Follow-ups: refusal-stricter-fixes, refusal-looser-fixes, refusal-owner-rules, refusal-uncited-rewrites.
